description: This report summarizes research activities conducted at Argonne National Laboratory in support of the development, qualification and certification of additively manufactured (AM) metallic components to allow for innovative reactor design and licensing. In this program, AM 316L stainless steel (SS) was evaluated in both light water reactor (LWR) environments as well as at higher temperatures expected in advanced reactors.
title: Mechanical Testing of Additively Manufactured Materials
